title: Miniature witch kitchen set for dollhouse in 1:12 scale 2
description: A handcrafted miniature witch kitchen scene featuring a basket of mushrooms, a pumpkin, grapes, apples, berries, candles, old books, herbs, autumn leaves, tiny papers, and a little cauldron with a magical potion. Every tiny detail was carefully made and painted by hand. All items are securely glued to the base, so the set is ready to use as one complete miniature scene. Perfect for dollhouse decoration, witch kitchen displays, Halloween decor, autumn scenes, fantasy dioramas…
